summary: Iteration 122: validated the new DB-driven /api/sitemap.xml, static sitemap index, robots.txt, SSR meta + Product/FAQPage schema enrichment, and re-ran the iteration-121 crawler regression. 36/38 pytest cases pass. All requested claims verified: 251 URLs, 0 duplicates, all on https://brightluxx.com, valid lastmod/changefreq/priority, 94 products + 15 blogs + 8 case studies present, no admin//api//cart URLs, sitemap index + robots directives correct, /api/health healthy, homepage renders. The iteration-121 CRITICAL crawler-404 defect is FIXED: a full sweep of all 251 sitemap URLs with a Googlebot UA returns 0 non-200 (also 0 non-200 for Chrome UA). TWO NEW real defects found: (1) 8 of the 251 sitemap URLs 301-redirect (WP legacy redirect map), including /products/cube-led-display-p3 which is a LIVE DB product now permanently redirected to /products, i.e. an orphaned product page; (2) the sitemap queries 4 collections with {status: 'published'} but those collections have no status field at all, so they contribute 0 URLs — 12 live /pixelvue/<slug> product pages are missing from the sitemap. Also found that the SSR meta in-memory cache served STALE pre-enrichment responses (schemas: null for /blog/microled-vs-oled-2025) until POST /api/ssr/meta/clear-cache was called.

critical.issue: 8 sitemap URLs are 301 redirects (GSC 'Page with redirect'): /led-screen-dubai, /led-display-abu-dhabi, /led-screen-saudi-arabia, /led-screen-qatar, /led-screen-kuwait, /digital-experience, /resource-library, /products/cube-led-display-p3. Worst case: /products/cube-led-display-p3 exists in the products collection (with FAQ + Product schema served by /api/ssr/meta) but prerender-server.js WP_REDIRECTS (line 368) and backend/routes/redirects.py (line 26) 301 it to /products — a real, schema-enriched product page is unreachable AND advertised in the sitemap. Either drop these paths from the sitemap (filter against the redirect map) or remove the stale redirect entries.

Sections 4/8/9/10 of routes/sitemap.py filter on {"status": "published"}, but pixelvue_products, applications_content, technologies_content and inspirations have NO status field (verified: distinct('status') == []). All four queries return zero documents, so those blocks are dead code. Concrete SEO loss: 12 live PixelVue product pages are missing from the sitemap (eagle-wing, iflex-pro, itransformers, ellipse-counter, creative-shapes, interactive, crystalflex, rolling-floor, magicstage, magic-blanket, magicsky, magic-garments) — /pixelvue/eagle-wing renders real content (H1 'Eagle Wing'). The other 12 pixelvue URLs only appear because they are hardcoded in STATIC_ROUTES, so the hardcoded list is already stale vs the DB.

minor.issue: STALE CACHE: /api/ssr/meta?path=/blog/microled-vs-oled-2025 returned schemas: null even though all 15 blogs have faq data; it only started returning FAQPage after POST /api/ssr/meta/clear-cache. _meta_cache has no TTL and is only cleared when it exceeds 500 entries, so any content/schema change silently serves stale meta to crawlers until a manual purge. Add a TTL or invalidate the cache from the admin content-save paths.

No noindex/draft filtering: page_seo entries are added regardless of their noindex flag, and products/blogs are added with no status filter. Currently harmless (0 noindex rows, all products/blogs published) but a single future draft or noindex page will leak into the sitemap.

case_studies uses is_published (not status) — the code comment says 'no status field, all records are published', which is true today (is_published False = 0) but the correct filter is {"is_published": {"$ne": false}}.
Every DB block is wrapped in a bare `except Exception: pass`, so a failing collection silently shrinks the sitemap with no log. Log the exception.

Playbook deviation: seed does NOT update an existing admin's password when ADMIN_SEED_PASSWORD changes (only inserts when missing). Also seed_email falls back to a hardcoded default 'admin@brightluxx.com' instead of failing fast.
The sitemapindex entry has no <lastmod>; harmless but Google prefers it.
Called twice on every PUBLIC page load and returns 401 x2 (visible as console errors on the homepage). Gate the session probe to admin routes or treat 401 as a normal anonymous state.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration errors in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' and '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' on /case-studies/* (CaseStudyDetail lines 274-277). Caused by wrapper spans injected around the dynamic <tr> map; move the dynamic wrapper outside the table or render rows without an intermediate span.

integration_issues.flow: Structured data in initial HTML (rich snippets)
integration_issues.issue: 31 of the 251 sitemap pages are served with ZERO application/ld+json in the initial HTML: all 8 /case-studies/*, all 9 /applications/*, /digital-experience-architecture + 3 /digital-experience/*, 3 /contractors/*, 4 /latest-tech/*, /sla-guide, /supplier-registration, /technical-support, /lp/specifier-toolkit. Case studies do get Organization/WebSite/BreadcrumbList/Article after JS hydration, but /applications/* have NO schema even after hydration. Blog pages only receive FAQPage in the HTML (Article/BreadcrumbList arrive client-side only), and after hydration a blog page emits BreadcrumbList TWICE (duplicate schema).

applications_content slugs (retail-signage, corporate-av, entertainment, transportation, broadcasting) do not resolve: /applications/retail-signage renders 'Application Not Found' while the frontend uses a different slug set (/applications/retail etc.). The CMS collection appears orphaned/unused.

action_items: Remove the 8 redirecting URLs from the sitemap (or filter sitemap output against WP_REDIRECTS / routes/redirects.py). Decide what to do with /products/cube-led-display-p3: it is a live DB product with full Product+FAQ schema but is 301'd to /products — either delete the stale redirect (recommended) or unpublish the product.

Fix the {status: 'published'} filters in routes/sitemap.py for pixelvue_products, applications_content, technologies_content and inspirations — those collections have no status field, so the queries return nothing and 12 live /pixelvue/<slug> pages are missing. Use {'status': {'$ne': 'draft'}} or drop the filter. Then remove the hardcoded pixelvue paths from STATIC_ROUTES so the DB is the single source of truth.
Add a TTL (or admin-save invalidation) to _meta_cache in routes/ssr_meta.py — it served schemas: null for blog pages until manually purged, which would silently ship rich-snippet-less HTML to Google.

Emit structured data in the initial HTML for the 31 pages that have none — at minimum Article/CreativeWork for the 8 case studies and something for the 9 /applications/* pages (they have no schema even after hydration). Also add Article/BlogPosting to the server-injected blog schemas and de-duplicate the double BreadcrumbList.
Fix the CaseStudyDetail table hydration errors (span inside tbody / tr inside span).
Filter noindex page_seo rows and non-published products/blogs out of the sitemap defensively; replace the bare `except Exception: pass` blocks with logging.
Make the admin seed update an existing admin's password when ADMIN_SEED_PASSWORD changes, and remove the hardcoded email default.
Stop calling /api/admin/me on public pages (2 x 401 per page load).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/sitemap.py mixes a 140-line hardcoded STATIC_ROUTES map with DB queries; the hardcoded map already diverges from the DB (pixelvue) and includes paths the app 301-redirects. Derive the sitemap from the router/DB and validate it against the redirect map in CI.

Silent failure is the recurring theme in this codebase: 10 bare `except Exception: pass` blocks in sitemap.py, status filters that match nothing, and (last iteration) regexes that never match. Any of these shrinks the sitemap or drops schema with zero signal — add assertions/logs and a CI check that URL count never drops.
A sitemap that lists 301s is actively harmful for indexation; add a build/CI test asserting every <loc> returns 200 without redirect (test already provided: TestSitemapNoRedirects).

success_rate.backend: 95% (36/38 pytest cases pass; 2 failures are the real sitemap redirect + pixelvue coverage defects)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (homepage/products/blog/case-study/product pages all render with correct unique titles and 0 non-200 across all 251 sitemap URLs; deductions for missing structured data on 31 pages and CaseStudyDetail hydration errors)

seed_data_creation: None. No data created or modified. The brute-force test consumed the 60s login rate-limit window for the test IP (self-healing).
test_credentials: admin@brightluxx.com / brightluxx2025 — verified working. Auth playbook checks PASS: password hash starts with $2b$, login sets httpOnly+Secure blx_access/blx_refresh cookies, /api/admin/me works via cookie and 401s anonymously, wrong password rejected, 429 lockout after 5 failed attempts, backend CORS echoes the explicit origin with allow-credentials: true (the preview ingress rewrites Access-Control-Allow-Origin to '*' on the public URL, so that header must be asserted against localhost:8001).
context_for_next_testing_agent: VERIFIED GOOD (no need to re-test unless sitemap.py/prerender changes): 251 URLs, 0 duplicates, base URL, lastmod/changefreq/priority validity, 94 products + 15 blogs + 8 case studies counts, no admin//api//cart URLs, static sitemap index, robots.txt Sitemap+Disallow directives, /api/health, /api/ssr/meta Product+FAQPage for products (12-product sample) and FAQPage for ALL 15 blogs, 422 on missing path, and — the iteration-121 CRITICAL fix — 0/251 non-200 for both Googlebot and Chrome UAs. RUN `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration122_sitemap.py -p no:randomly` after fixes: TestSitemapNoRedirects (8 redirecting URLs) and TestPixelVueCoverage (12 missing pixelvue pages) must go green; TestSitemapStructure::test_url_count_251 will need its expected count bumped once the pixelvue pages are added and the redirects removed. Use /app/tests/sweep_redirects_122.py for the full 251-URL redirect + ld+json sweep. Environment quirks to not misreport as bugs: the preview ingress adds X-Robots-Tag: noindex,nofollow and Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * to every response and rewrites Cache-Control to no-store (backend correctly sets public, max-age=3600 on the sitemap).
rca_of_the_issue: Defect 1 (sitemap lists 301s): the sitemap is built from page_seo + a hardcoded STATIC_ROUTES map, neither of which is cross-checked against the WP legacy redirect map that exists in TWO places (frontend/prerender-server.js WP_REDIRECTS line 355+ and backend/routes/redirects.py line 12+). 5 legacy geo slugs live in page_seo, /resource-library is in STATIC_ROUTES, and /products/cube-led-display-p3 was later re-created as a real product in the products collection while its legacy redirect entry was never removed — so the DB-driven block emits a URL that the proxy 301s to /products. Reproduce: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}' -A 'Googlebot/2.1' <preview>/products/cube-led-display-p3 -> 301 /products. Defect 2 (missing pixelvue pages): routes/sitemap.py sections 4/8/9/10 filter {'status': 'published'} against collections that never had a status field (db.pixelvue_products.distinct('status') == []), so the async cursors yield nothing and the bare except/pass hides the emptiness; the 12 pixelvue URLs that do appear come from the hardcoded STATIC_ROUTES, masking the bug. Reproduce: pytest tests/test_iteration122_sitemap.py::TestPixelVueCoverage. Defect 3 (stale SSR schemas): _meta_cache in routes/ssr_meta.py is a plain dict with no TTL, cleared only when len > 500, so entries cached before the FAQ/Product enrichment shipped kept returning schemas: null; POST /api/ssr/meta/clear-cache fixed it immediately.
